description: This file contains React components and utility functions for UI elements such as modals, popovers, lists, icons, loading indicators, and interaction handlers within a web application.

methods.name: Popover
methods.description: A React component that renders a popover element with children and optional content, handling open/close states.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A React component for a styled container that groups children and optional classes.

methods.name: ListItem
methods.description: A React component representing an item in a list, with optional icon, subtitle, and click handler.

methods.name: List
methods.description: A React component that renders a list container.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: A React component displaying a centered loading indicator.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: A React component for modal dialogs with header, content, actions, and close handling.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: A function that dynamically creates and displays a modal component.

methods.name: Toast
methods.description: A React component for temporary notification messages with optional action buttons.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: A function to show toast notifications with delay and optional actions.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A React textarea component with optional auto-resize.

methods.name: PasswordInput
methods.description: A React component that toggles password visibility with an icon button.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: A styled select dropdown component with icon.

methods.name: showConfirm
methods.description: A function that shows a confirmation dialog and returns a Promise resolving to true/false.

methods.name: PromptInput
methods.description: Internal component for input within a prompt/modal for user text input.

methods.name: showPrompt
methods.description: A function that shows a prompt modal and returns a Promise with user input.

methods.name: showImageModal
methods.description: Display an image in a modal popup.

methods.name: Selector
methods.description: UI component to select from a list of items, with optional multiple or single selection.
